name: Castle Melmereth
description: The castle where Ravidel resides and which is destroyed.

description_citations.text: "The Shadow Mage". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ravidel conquers Arathoxia; Jared steals the Lotus, leads refugees against Ravidel at Castle Melmereth and summons a Shivan Dragon.
timeline.quote: Ravidel tracked Jared down and conquered Arathoxia

citation.text: "Jared Carthalion", section "Revenge". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jared retrieves Geyadrone Dihada's spellbook at Castle Melmereth despite Sandruu's interference.
timeline.quote: Though he struggled, Jared managed to escape with the spellbook.

citation.text: "Planeswalker War", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Adam Carthalion's army is destroyed at the Battle of Aster Fall and Ravidel takes up residence in Castle Melmereth.
timeline.quote: After Adam died in the Battle of Aster Fall , Ravidel took up residence in the castle.

citation.text: "Stonehaven", section "Stonehaven locations". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jared Carthalion and Yorgo infiltrate Melmereth and Jared summons a Shivan Dragon, destroying it.
timeline.quote: Jared summoned a Shivan Dragon , resulting in the fortress's destruction

citation.text: "Stonehaven", section "Stonehaven locations". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In Castle Melmereth Ravidel reveals Adam was a liar and killer who murdered Gwendolyn for power and planned to sacrifice Jared before changing his mind.
timeline.quote: He murdered his wife Gwendolyn Carthalion in the hopes that it would grant him power to become a Planeswalker .

citation.text: "The Shadow Mage", section "Volume 4: First Duel". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Freed by the vizier's death, Liana is able to act against Ravidel and enters the castle with Ezer.
timeline.quote: this newly discovered freedom from her oath finally enables Liana to take direct action against Ravidel

citation.text: "The Shadow Mage", section "Volume 4: First Duel". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Narok kills Nikko and Jared annihilates Narok, then crushes the Black Lotus to summon a Shivan Dragon that destroys the castle; Ezer dies, and the castle explodes from Liana's sorcery.
timeline.quote: Jared crushes the Black Lotus and summons a Shivan Dragon

citation.text: "The Shadow Mage", section "Volume 4: First Duel". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
